HCDD 113.name: Foundations of Human-Centered Design and Development
HCDD 113.description: Introductory course examining theories, models, and tools for human-centered design through practice-based inquiry.

HCDD 113S.name: Foundations of Human-Centered Design and Development FYS
HCDD 113S.description: First-Year Seminar version of HCDD 113 with identical content and approach.

HCDD 264.name: Design Practice in Human-Centered Design and Development
HCDD 264.description: Methods and tools for designing technology-enabled experiences, emphasizing iterative design cycles.

HCDD 311.name: Object-Oriented Design and Software Applications
HCDD 311.description: Object-oriented design principles, modeling, and application development lifecycle management.

HCDD 340.name: Human-Centered Design for Mobile Computing
HCDD 340.description: Mobile computing technology, design concepts, and development projects in health and developing regions.

HCDD 361.name: Application Development Design Studio II
HCDD 361.description: Studio course practicing technical skills through project-based experiential learning and peer critique.

HCDD 364W.name: Methods for Studying Users
HCDD 364W.description: Qualitative and quantitative research methods for studying users and evaluating interactive systems.

HCDD 411.name: Distributed-Object Computing
HCDD 411.description: Distributed-object and client/server computing concepts for real-world system design and deployment.

HCDD 412.name: The Engineering of Complex Software Systems
HCDD 412.description: Software engineering fundamentals including design, implementation, testing, and iterative development.

HCDD 440.name: Human-Centered Design and Development Capstone Course
HCDD 440.description: Semester-long capstone project integrating core curriculum knowledge with team collaboration and professional communication skills.
